plugins.name: local-backlog
plugins.description: For projects without access to a cloud-based issue tracker: create and manage stories as plain Markdown files, with auto-incrementing ticket codes and a searchable local viewer (served on localhost via Python's built-in HTTP server — no third-party account, no cloud dependency). "Local" means no external service dependency, not necessarily private — files can be gitignored or committed with the rest of the repo, by choice.
